{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dual Stream DS-001 thruster component''' was produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] thrusters, the component increased the regeneration rate for engine power by allowing thrusters to intake stray radiation particles and thus draw in energy for the ship.
